name: Peat
author: E. T. Carter
description: A cross-section of dark ground with faint soil strata; a buried seam smoulders from within, its travelling front never seen directly — read only as stitched threads of ember light leaking up through vertical fissures, graded warm-to-cool as it climbs and dies just short of the surface.

params.label: Seam speed
params.effect: How fast the lit stretch travels along the buried seam.

params.label: Fissure density
params.effect: Spatial frequency of the vertical cracks the glow escapes through.

params.label: Glow reach
params.effect: How far in CSS px the seam light climbs up the fissures before dying out.

params.label: Ash ember
params.effect: Residual ember level left glowing in the seam behind the front; 0 cools it to pure black.
